reviews.title: Really helpful app for sleep
reviews.contents:
I don’t struggle consistently with insomnia or sleep issues, but there are just some nights when I can’t seem to stay asleep. This app has helped me recognize why this happens to me and I’m learning how I can teach myself to sleep better.

I feel really encouraged to keep going based on my success so far these past few weeks.

reviews.title: Great app for better sleep
reviews.contents: I can’t believe how easy Sleepio makes it to improve sleep! All the techniques are science-based but so simple to incorporate into a regular routine, and they actually work. I’ve been falling asleep faster and feeling better overall. Definitely worth a try

reviews.title: Finally a good night’s sleep
reviews.contents: Have struggled with sleep issues for a long time. Within a week of using Sleepio I was already sleeping better and after 2 weeks I had my first full night of sleep in a long time

reviews.title: User friendly and very helpful
reviews.contents: Sleepio is incredibly user friendly and has the information and techniques most useful to people dealing with sleep issues. I’ve learned so much from this app

reviews.title: Sleeping better than a baby
reviews.contents: I feel like I’ve tried everything, this is the first practice that has made a difference

reviews.title: Does not sync with Apple health
reviews.contents: I’ve been tracking my sleep with Apple Watch. This app looks interesting yet it does not even have the most basic feature of syncing the sleep data from the health center, you basically have to manually record how many hours did you sleep each night.

reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.contents: App lately has been freezing and crashing allot. Also would be good if app could connect with other apps such as apple health or garmin to pull sleep data

reviews.title: Not automated
reviews.contents: Ironic a company called “Big Health” can’t make an app that uses sleep tracker data.

reviews.title: What a Waste of
reviews.contents: Can’t use it without an employer or healthcare provider referral and neither my work or doctor will offer this. Thanks for absolutely nothing, Sleepio!

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.contents: The app gets stuck and won’t scroll
